# First, search for hotels based on the initial criteria
hotels_search_results = search_hotels(
    city="Colorado Springs",
    checkin_date=["January 16, 2026"],
    checkout_date=["January 29, 2026"],
    num_people=1,
    budget=55,
    stars=[3, 5],
    neighborhood=["Downtown Colorado Springs"]
)
save_to_cache(key="initial_hotels_search", value=hotels_search_results)

# Next, filter the hotels by the neighborhood (though it was included in search, this is a good practice if the initial search was broad)
# Since the neighborhood was provided in the last turn, we use filter_hotels on the initial search result.
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels_search_results,
    neighborhood=["Downtown Colorado Springs"]
)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels_by_neighborhood", value=filtered_hotels)

# Now, search for restaurants in Colorado Springs with Icelandic cuisine and a 3.0 rating
restaurants_search_results = search_restaurants(
    city="Colorado Springs",
    cuisine=["Icelandic"],
    rating=[3.0, 3.0]
)
save_to_cache(key="initial_restaurants_search", value=restaurants_search_results)

# Finally, find the nearest restaurants to the hotels
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    restaurants=restaurants_search_results,
    groupBy="hotel"
)
save_to_cache(key="nearest_restaurants_to_hotels", value=nearest_restaurants)

print(nearest_restaurants)
